name: zaymo
description: Test, QA and improve Klaviyo email: design split and holdout tests, read results honestly, audit flows for duplicate sends, and catch inbox rendering traps before you send. Connects to Zaymo for live tests, analytics and interactive email.

interface.longDescription:
Zaymo connects ChatGPT to your Klaviyo email program. Ask questions of your email, flow and order data in plain language; audit flows for duplicate and overlapping sends; design and launch split and holdout tests on your Klaviyo flows and campaigns, with traffic that moves toward the better arm as evidence builds; read test results with confidence intervals; and inspect and edit interactive emails (AMP and Apple Mail) built in Zaymo. Changes that reach customers are previewed in the conversation and only applied after you confirm.

The bundled skills work on their own: test design, honest result reading, flow audits and pre-send email QA. The Zaymo connector requires a Zaymo account with Klaviyo connected.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Klaviyo flows for duplicate and overlapping sends
Design a test of 10% vs $10 off in my abandoned cart flow
Is the winner of my latest email test a real result?
